name: factor_ideation_out_of_sample
design: The model proposes factor expressions using only data from the ideation window (2021-2023) for 000001. Every valid expression is then replayed unchanged on 2024-2025 for three symbols. No evaluation-window data is shown to the model.
limits: A finite-case out-of-sample feasibility check, not evidence of investment alpha. Costs, execution and adjustment follow the V2 backtest assumptions.
